covered.label: S-tog (A, B, Bx, C, E, F, H)
covered.detail: Shown at Nørreport, Nørrebro, København H and Nordhavn, where it shares a station with the Metro. Nordhavn does not get the H line (H doesn't stop there).

covered.label: DSB Regional, InterCity, InterCityLyn and Öresundståg (to Malmö/Lund)
covered.detail: Shown at Nørreport, Nørrebro, København H and Nordhavn only, where they share a station with the Metro.

notCovered.label: EuroCity (to Hamburg), SJ X2000 (to Stockholm), České dráhy ComfortJet (to Prague)
notCovered.detail: Excluded - booking a seat is compulsory.

notCovered.label: Harbour buses (Havnebus)
notCovered.detail: Not covered - these are buses, not trains.

stations: 44 Metro stations, plus S-tog/DSB/Öresundståg at 4 of them.
notes: Schedule times only - no live Rejseplanen API key is registered yet, so times are the printed timetable, not real-time running information. Kongens Nytorv is the M1/M2/M3/M4 hub and never has S-tog or DSB trains; M3 (Cityringen) is a ring with no end stop, so its direction is shown as clockwise/counter-clockwise rather than a destination.
